name: telegram-archive-viewer
description: Read-only web interface for browsing Telegram messages archived by the Telegram Archive backup container. Search messages, view media, and browse chat statistics with optional authentication. Requires the Telegram Archive backup container to have run at least once. Point the backup paths to the same directories used by the backup container (read-only recommended). More info: https://github.com/GeiserX/Telegram-Archive

paths.name: Backups
paths.description: Backup data directory (read-only, shared with backup container)

paths.name: Database
paths.description: SQLite database directory (read-only, shared with backup container)

variables.name: Username
variables.description: Web viewer login username (empty = no auth)

variables.name: Show Stats
variables.description: Show chat statistics in the viewer
